So, what’s the difference?

Both mattresses use Purple’s pressure-relieving grid. The big split is what sits underneath it, and how that changes support, bounce, and airflow.

Feature The Original The All-New
Support system Foam base Responsive support coils plus base support
Feel Balanced, medium-firm comfort More lift, more airflow, more bounce
Best for People who want the classic Purple feel People who want more spring and support
Core story Simple all-foam build with Purple’s signature grid Hybrid construction with extra structure underneath
